We have detection of protecting groups, including TBDMS (tert-butyldimethylsilyl). The deprotected molecule would have the OH instead of OSi... So we need to generate SMILES without the silyl group. Could manually edit SMILES: replace O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C with O (i.e., OH). The original SMILES: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO

Replace O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C with O. So deprotected SMILES: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO

That matches second precursor pair first element (the product with no silyl). Indeed second pair first element is "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" actually includes silyl after O? Wait second pair first element: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' That's product with silyl attached to terminal CO? Actually O after CO? Not needed.

But deprotected product likely is C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO

Let's search template catalog with this deprotected SMILES.
